platform_scope: Android native Ink Playground on a qualified Android device

android_functional_smoke.host: Android API 26 or newer, arm64-v8a or x86_64
required_observations: APK identity and SHA-256 are recorded
install and launcher Activity start successfully
MotionEvent batches including historical samples reach the native host
multiple strokes render with independent stroke boundaries
pointer trace and screen capture path plus SHA-256 are persisted

android_pressure_qualified.host: Android API 26 or newer with a pressure-capable stylus
required_observations: pressure values vary across a controlled trace
HUD telemetry and capture-bound physical latency are persisted

verification_mapping.requirement: A runnable Android host accepts native input and presents a writable surface
verification_mapping.failure_mode: A library builds but no installable Activity or responsive surface exists
verification_mapping.oracle: APK install/launch plus repeated-stroke smoke with capture

verification_mapping.requirement: Android pointer history reaches the production host
verification_mapping.failure_mode: Only the latest MotionEvent is forwarded or stroke boundaries are lost
verification_mapping.oracle: Persisted pointer trace with historical sample count and per-stroke IDs

verification_mapping.requirement: Android pressure is preserved when a pressure stylus exists
verification_mapping.failure_mode: Touch or non-pressure input is misreported as pressure capability
verification_mapping.oracle: Independent device metadata and varying-pressure trace
